messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty ALERT fired for service=synthetic-checks-eu environment=prod severity=page
pagerduty: Incident #INC-2026: synth-check-eu-west-1-series — triggered by threshold breach (5xx rate) — paging escalation policy: oncall-sre -> eng-runtime -> platform-leads
ryan (on-call): I got the page, looking. Assigned to me in PD, acked. :thumbsup:
maria (SRE): I'm on standby, pulling canary run logs. Can you share which probe sets are failing? ryan, tag me in PD?
ryan (on-call): PD shows 12 failing canaries across 3 hosts in eu-west-1, majority short 503s, some long tail latency. Attaching quick logs below.
ryan (on-call): ```
2026-03-14T10:05:12Z synth-prober[eu-west-1] ERROR request failed status=503 model=redwood-13b prompt=len>512
2026-03-14T10:05:13Z synth-prober[eu-west-1] WARN retrying host=node-az3-gpu-07 latency_ms=1200
2026-03-14T10:05:14Z synth-prober[eu-west-1] ERROR kv-cache-miss downstream-timeout
```
sasha (eng-runtime): Noted. Any config change or rollout recently in eu-west-1? I don't see active rollouts in console for hosted models; checking dedicated pools.
ops-bot: Detected a recent autoscaler activity at 2026-03-14T09:59:xx in eu-west-1: scale-down of pool gpu-pool-4 -> from 6 -> 4 instances (policy=cost-saving)
maria (SRE): That autoscale down overlaps. Hypothesis: reduced pool caused transient queueing -> 503s on prober. Can we temporarily bump pool to previous size and drain backlog?
ryan (on-call): Initiating scale-up command now (manual override). Command: ```redwoodctl scale gpu-pool-4 --replicas 6 --reason "pager triggered"``` — running.
pagerduty: Acknowledgement recorded: ryan (on-call) — escalation paused.
jamie (support): Heads up — Support ticketing shows two customers reporting higher latencies for embeddings in EU since ~09:58. I've opened a high-priority support thread and pinged affected accounts.
sasha (eng-runtime): While scale-up in progress, can we enable fallback routing to a cheaper variant in eu-central to reduce error rate? Suggest adding routing policy: prefer eu-central on failures for synth-checks-eu service.
maria (SRE): Agree. ryan can you flip the routing override? Command: ```redwoodctl routing override synth-checks-eu --fallback-region eu-central --duration 15m``` — this should reduce customer error surface.
ryan (on-call): Done. Override applied, confirmed via console. Rolling window 15m.
ops-bot: Scale-up completed: gpu-pool-4 replicas=6, new nodes join health=passing.
incident-bot: Canary failure count dropping: 12 -> 3 -> 0 over 6m. Alert suppression in PD will auto-resolve once steady.
sasha (eng-runtime): I'm running a memory/latency sweep on the new nodes to ensure no kernel/backpressure patterns. Posting any suspicious traces.
maria (SRE): Quick customer-impact summary for postmortem: - timeframe: 09:58–10:07 UTC - scope: synthetic checks in eu-west-1; some real customers saw elevated latency and 5xx for embeddings/endpoints (~up to 3% of requests for a small subset) - root cause hypothesis: aggressive autoscaler scale-down prior to load spike causing queueing and transient 503s - mitigation: manual scale-up, routing override to eu-central, dynamic autoscaler policy rollback pending review.
jamie (support): Communicated status to affected customers. Notifying them we'll follow-up with RCA. No major revenue-impacting outages reported so far.
ryan (on-call): PD incident updated and set to resolved after stability window. I'll file an on-call handoff note and assign follow-up to eng-runtime and SRE for RCA. Tagging sasha, maria.
sasha (eng-runtime): I'll own the runtime side RCA — will look at autoscaler metrics, kernel queues, and probe handling logic. ETA preliminary findings: 3 hours.
maria (SRE): I'll own the incident timeline and customer impact writeup. Scheduling postmortem ridealong in #postmortems in 48h.
ops-bot: Incident INC-2026 marked resolved by ryan at 2026-03-14T10:19:30Z
ryan (on-call): Thanks team. If anyone sees residual flapping re-open PD. Closing thread here. :white_check_mark:
